text:
jordan: quick thread to decide pilot scope for the Optimize Toolkit (alerts + recommendations). goal: get a narrow, testable pilot that covers batching, caching hints, and quantization suggestions tied to eval regressions.

priya: propose pilot rules: per-deployment (hosted/dedicated) x per-model granularity. Deployment matters because latency SLOs differ. keep default thresholds conservative.

oscar: agree on per-deployment+per-model. detection windows: 12h rolling for noisy signals, 48h for sustained drift. signal = weighted combination: pass_rate_drop (60%), latency_increase (20%), token_cost_spike (20%).

jordan: interesting — combine econ + quality. for actions: recommend only for batching/caching/quant first (no auto-deploy changes). allow human-approved recommendation to be applied.

tara: customers want: 1) inline explanation for recommendation 2) opt-out per-model 3) preview simulation of expected cost/latency change before applying.

priya: sample alert payload (JSON): {
  "model": "m-rex-1",
  "deployment": "hosted-us",
  "signals": {"pass_rate_drop_pct": 5, "latency_p90_increase_ms": 80},
  "recommendations": ["enable_prefix_cache", "batching:target=32", "quant:fp16->int8_preview"]
}

oscar: pilot acceptance: 1) recommendations surfaced in Console UI + webhook 2) customers can simulate impact (local estimator) 3) pilot across 4 customers (mix hosted/dedicated) for 3 weeks with <15% false-suggest rate.

jordan: scope decisions: no auto-apply for MVP, include mute/snooze + per-model sensitivity slider, surface cost delta estimate. owners: priya (product), oscar (ml/econ), jordan (launch).

infra-bot: CI: recommendations-service tests passing, canary deploy queued.

tara: I'll draft the customer-facing explanation language and the simulation inputs we need. also collecting pilot volunteers.

priya: rough timeline: infra & metrics hookup (2w), UI + webhook (2w), simulation estimator (1w) -> 5w.

oscar: follow-ups: write the signal-weighting doc, add unit tests for combined score, create simple A/B to validate recommendations don't harm latency.

jordan: agreed. next: priya create GH epic + link to this thread, oscar produce sample estimator script, tara reach out to pilot customers. closing for now.
